description: The devices of one owner: the next stamp, what a change stamps, the merge of two states of a record per field and for the removal, when a record is deleted, the record message of a state, beginning to stamp, what a device does after STALE, what a device shows of a record received from another app, and one device with its siblings: the CHANGE, RESYNC and FORWARD messages it processes and sends, for the records of the set and for what the set got from other apps (spec/sync.md).

A second stamp in the same millisecond: the device counts
A millisecond later: the clock leads again
The device has seen a stamp of a sibling whose clock is an hour ahead
The clock was set back to 1970
A clock before 1970 and no stamp yet
highest is one below the clock's value
The last base from which a stamp can be taken
The same with the highest random part: the largest long
One above: no stamp, also with the lowest random part
A clock so far ahead that the product is above the largest long
highest is the largest long
the largest random part while the clock leads
the clock's value equals highest: the device counts
one above the last base: no stamp, also with the highest random part
highest is one below the largest long: no stamp
the last clock from which a stamp can be taken
the last clock, and highest is its value: the device counts
a clock of 2^48, whose product is 2^64: no stamp
the largest clock: no stamp
the smallest clock and no stamp yet
the smallest clock while the device counts
a clock before 1970 whose product is below the smallest long

a change of a field of a record that came back leaves the removal that stands as it is

taking back the deletion of a record of a type without fields

at the limit, one above that base no change begins, also with the lowest random parts

section 6.4, case 3: the tablet takes nothing

the higher stamp is later, also against the higher device key

equal stamps, and the own key is higher by its first byte, 80 above 7f
equal stamps, and the other key is higher in its last byte only
equal stamps, and the first byte that differs decides, not the bytes after it

equal stamps and keys: the own value is higher by its first byte that differs

equal stamps, keys and bytes under two schemas: the other field state has the higher schema

the values are not looked at when the keys differ: the higher key has the lower value

of two field states of unknown age, the one with the higher key stands, with its stamp -1
of two field states of unknown age with one key, the one with the higher value stands

a removal is later than a field state of unknown age
a device without a state takes the other state and a state stamp
a device without a state takes a state stamp also for a state without field states and removal
a state without field states and removal changes nothing on a device that holds one

the removal that only the own state holds stays
a removal that was taken back and that only the other state holds is taken as well

of two removals, the later one of the own state stays

of two removals with equal stamps and keys, the other one, which stands, is taken
of two removals with equal stamps and keys, the own one, which stands, stays
a record of a type without fields comes back by a removal that was taken back

a deletion after the record came back deletes it again, in the place of the older removal

a field state with the stamp of the removal and a lower key: the record is deleted

a device that discarded the field states of a deleted record takes them again
the new state stamp is above the state stamp of the other state
the own removal stays while a field state of the other state is taken
the state stamp of the other state counts as seen when nothing is taken
the state stamp is taken from the clock when the clock leads
at the limit, the state stamp of a merge can be the largest long, from the last base
at the limit, one above the last base, the device takes the field state and has no state stamp
at the limit, a device accepts the largest long as a stamp of a sibling and has no state stamp
at the limit, a device that can take no stamp takes the removal and has no state stamp
at the limit, a device that can take no stamp keeps its state stamp when it takes nothing
at the limit, a device without a state that can take no stamp takes the state and no state stamp
an owner's layer: a later null value is taken over a value
an owner's layer: a later value is taken over a null value
an owner's layer: with equal stamps and device keys the empty bytes are taken over a null value
an owner's layer: with equal stamps and device keys a null value is not taken over the empty bytes
an owner's layer: two null values with equal stamps and device keys, the higher schema is taken
an owner's layer: two null values with equal stamps and device keys, the lower schema is not taken
an owner's layer: a removal that is not later than a field state with a null value does not delete
an owner's layer: a removal that is later than a field state with a null value deletes
a keep: one that the device does not hold is taken
keeps: the higher version stands over a higher stamp, a keep for an older deletion never takes the place of one for a newer deletion
keeps: the higher version is taken
keeps: with equal versions the higher stamp is taken
keeps: with equal versions and stamps the higher device key is taken
keeps: with all three equal the keep that is given up is taken
keeps: with all three equal a keep that is not given up is not taken over one that is
keeps: the same keep is no part taken
keeps: a keep given up for a newer deletion stands over a keep for an older one
the state stamp of the other state is the highest the device has seen from a sibling
a lower state stamp of the other state leaves the highest one the device has seen
a merge that takes nothing leaves the state stamp below the version to pass, which stays
a merge that takes a field state gives a state stamp above the version to pass, which is dropped
no removal: there
a removal that was taken back: there, whatever the stamps of the field states
a removal that was taken back and no field state: there
a removal that stands, and no field state: deleted
a removal that stands and is later than every field state: deleted
a removal that stands and is not later than one of the field states: there
a removal with the stamp of a field state and the higher key: deleted
a removal with the stamp of a field state and the lower key: there
a removal with the stamp of a field state and a key that is lower in the first byte, 7f below 80
a removal with the stamp and the key of a field state: there
a removal with the stamp 1 is later than fields never stamped, whatever the keys
a type without fields and no removal: there
the version is the state stamp, not the highest field stamp
a counted version stands in the place of the state stamp
a record deleted while the installation counted: the counted version stays below the removal
a state for which the device could take no state stamp is not sent
no DATA with a writer schema that lacks a field whose stamped field state a later version wrote
a stamped field state of an earlier version, whose field the writer schema removed, bars nothing
a field state of a later version whose field the writer schema has bars nothing
a field never stamped that the writer schema lacks does not hold the record back
a writer schema with a field of which the device holds no field state
a DELETE is sent also with a writer schema that lacks a field of a later version
an installation that deleted no record while it counted takes no stamp
one stamp for each record deleted while it counted; the counted versions stay
at the limit, an installation that can take no stamp for a deleted record does not begin
not above the device's own version: nothing more, and a device that counted goes on counting
not above a state stamp the device saw from a sibling in a merge: nothing more
above, with siblings: the version counts as seen and is kept as the version to pass
above, with siblings, below the device's highest stamp: highest stays
above, with siblings, and above the version to pass of an earlier STALE: the higher one is kept
above, with siblings, and below the version to pass of an earlier STALE: that one is kept
above, on the only device of a set, which counted: it stamps and sends again at once
above, on the only device of a set whose clock is behind: the new state stamp is above it
at the limit, the largest long as a version: the only device sends nothing and keeps it to pass
above, on the only device of a set, which may not send the record: nothing is sent
the state stamp is still below the version to pass: a new state stamp, and the record is sent
a merge gave the device a state stamp above the version to pass: no new state stamp
the state stamp is below the version to pass, and the clock leads
below the version to pass on a device that may not send the record: nothing, and it is kept
at the limit, below the version to pass on a device that can take no stamp: it is kept
no record message and no owner's layer: the record is not there
no record message: the record is not there, whatever the owner's layer holds
the record is there and has no owner's layer: every field has the sender's value
the record is there: a field has the owner's value if the layer holds one for it
a field state with a null value is no owner's value: the sender's value shows
an owner's value for a field that the kept DATA does not have is not shown
a removal that stands and is later than every field state: deleted by the owner
a removal that stands and no field state: deleted by the owner
a removal that was taken back: the record is there, with the owner's values
a removal that stands and a later owner's value: deleted by the owner, whatever the stamps
a removal that stands and a later field state with a null value: deleted by the owner
a tombstone and no owner's layer: deleted by its sender
a tombstone and owner's values without a keep: deleted by its sender, owner's values keep nothing
a keep of the version of the DELETE: kept, the DATA beside the tombstone with the owner's values
a keep of a version above that of the DELETE: kept
a keep without an owner's value keeps nothing: deleted by its sender
a keep whose owner's values were all discarded keeps nothing: deleted by its sender
a keep of a version below that of the DELETE: deleted by its sender
a keep that was given up, of the version of the DELETE: deleted by its sender
a keep that was given up, of a version above that of the DELETE: deleted by its sender
a keep, but no DATA beside the tombstone: deleted by its sender
a keep and an owner's removal that stands: deleted by the owner
a keep and an owner's removal that was taken back: kept
a CHANGE of the device's own key is ignored

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. fields.name: relations

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location

texts.label: Location

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. texts.label: Reminders

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. vectors.description: a record with field states of unknown age is part of the answer to a RESYNC, like any record

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: a device takes from a file of its own set no DELETE, and no DATA that fails as a record message

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. fields.name: all_day
