descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: a forwarded DEVICE_ADD that joins two senders: one sender, the records by the version rule, and the owner's layers merged under a new state stamp

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: STALE for a forward is taken as DUPLICATE; the first outcome stands, and an entry for another id is ignored

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: an entry with the version 2 is no outcome of a forward

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: an ACK of a sibling with the outcome MERGED for a forward is not valid, and delivers nothing

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: a later version takes the place of a kept message: it is forwarded anew, and an outcome for the forward of the earlier one delivers nothing

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: after FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED for the message inside of a sibling for a FORWARD, the forward is settled

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: after NOT_ACCEPTED of a sibling for a FORWARD, the forward is settled

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.

vectors.description: after DEVICE_REJECTED of a sibling for a FORWARD, the forward is settled

descriptions.name: appointment
descriptions.doc: An appointment: an event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

texts.label: Appointment
texts.help: An event at a time and possibly a place, such as a visit to the vet.

help_translations.de: Ein Ereignis zu einer Zeit und vielleicht an einem Ort, etwa ein Besuch beim Tierarzt.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: What the appointment is, as plain text on one line.

texts.label: Title
texts.help: What the appointment is, on one line.

help_translations.de: Worum es beim Termin geht, in einer Zeile.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: When the appointment starts, as a date and time on the wall clock, in a time zone or floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of its first day, floating.

texts.label: Start
texts.help: When the appointment starts.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin beginnt.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: When the appointment ends: the first moment after it, which is not part of it. It is in a time zone when start is, possibly another one, as for a flight, and floating when start is floating. For an all-day appointment, 00:00 of the day after its last day, floating. Null when no end is given; an all-day appointment without an end takes one day.

texts.label: End
texts.help: When the appointment is over.

help_translations.de: Wann der Termin vorbei ist.

fields.name: all_day
fields.doc: True when the appointment takes whole days; start and end are then floating at 00:00, and only their days count.

texts.label: All day
texts.help: On when the appointment takes whole days.

help_translations.de: An, wenn der Termin ganze Tage dauert.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the appointment takes place, as text, such as an address or a room. Empty when not given.

texts.label: Location
texts.help: Where the appointment takes place, such as an address or a room.

help_translations.de: Wo der Termin stattfindet, etwa eine Anschrift oder ein Raum.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the appointment, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

texts.label: Notes
texts.help: Anything else about the appointment.

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.
